result_text:
The per-rep purchase-order report no longer counts cancelled purchase orders. I added `po.status <> 'CANCELLED'` to the count subquery in `findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`. That's the same filter the other purchase-order queries use.

Reps with no purchase orders in the period are still listed with 0, and the ordering is unchanged.

I ran `mvn -q -o test -Dtest='SalesRepPurchaseOrder*'`, which printed nothing. I didn't check how many tests it matched, and I didn't add a test for the cancelled case or run your Anna/Bob example.
